## Requirement

Identify the requirement that should be changed.

<!-- Example: RF05, RNF03 -->

## Current requirement

Describe the requirement as it currently exists.

## Proposed change

Describe how the requirement should be modified.

## Justification

Explain why this requirement should be changed.

## Impact

Describe which parts of the system, documentation, or other requirements may be affected.

## Related issues

Link related features, bugs, refactorings, or other requirement changes.
